notes.title: Level Reset 1.0 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for your support and feedback! We are about to roll out our first major version update. This update will bring a more linear level experience, clearer strategic skill combinations, more balanced distribution of in-level and store resources, and significantly improved game efficiency. Both new and old players will enjoy a smoother gaming experience. Additionally, we have fixed numerous bugs reported by players.
[p align="justify"]95% of the levels have been reset:
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]● More linear level routes
[p align="justify"]● Easier difficulty to get started
[p align="justify"]● More rhythmic progression
[p align="justify"]● More balanced distribution of level resources
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Bug Fixes:
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]● Fixed the issue where some devices get stuck on the loading screen, preventing normal gameplay.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed air wall and obstruction bugs.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed monster spawn point duplication bugs.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed level continuity issues.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed the problem of overlapping teleport point positions with air walls.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed skill cooldown effects.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed skill silence effects.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed the healing skill bug of Nomadic Shamans.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed the bug with Stone Hammer's dying strike skill
[p align="justify"]● Fixed the normal attack damage bug of Cave Spiritists.
[p align="justify"]● Adjusted the dying explosion skill of Wilderness Stone Hammer.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed the summoning skill bug of Wilderness Archers.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed the issue where flying characters could be shot down by the protagonist.
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Important Note:
[p align="justify"]Due to the extensive nature of the reset content, old save data will not be compatible. We sincerely apologize for this inconvenience and ask for your understanding. We look forward to you having a better experience with the new content! We will continue to pay attention to your feedback and welcome suggestions in the community. Thank you for your patience!
[p align="justify"]— The Soul Revelation Development Team

notes.title: Trial version 1.02 update announcement
notes.content:
Content of this update:
1.Added the function of manually challenging the enemy squad.
2.Added WADS keys for movement, while retaining the right-click on the ground for movement.
3.Added random treasure chests in the grass and grass monsters.
4.If the equipment of our side is looted, it can be retrieved by killing the looters.
5.The vein crystals that have activated skills will be recycled after the units of our side die.
6.Simplified the guidance system.
7.Fixed the UI adaptation bugs for multiple languages.

Thank you to the players for their active feedback on the game content.

notes.title: Update Notice: Core Mechanics Overhaul
notes.content:
During the trial period, we collected extensive feedback from Soul • Apocalypto players. The predominant criticism focused on the overly frequent manual collection of soul balls, which led to gameplay fatigue.
Based on your input, we’ve prioritized the following key changes:

 1. Soul Furnace now auto-collects soul balls – no manual pickup required.
 2. Added Auto/Manual Merge toggle to the Soul Furnace.
 3. Drag Soul Cards from slots to character avatars or 3D models to upgrade allies and enhance stats.
 4. Soul Card capacity doubled from 8 to 16.
 5. Streamlined UI layout with enlarged critical elements for clarity.

We’ll continue monitoring feedback and iterating on improvements. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Trial version 1.01 update announcement
notes.content:
Contents of this update:
1. The basic operations have been reworked, and the operation of the soul ball has been changed to dragging.
2. The game has added support for Japanese and Korean (not fully tested).
3. The skill values ​​of the trial boss have been corrected.
4. Elite monsters have been added.
Thank you players for your positive feedback on the game content.

notes.title: Trial version update announcement
notes.content:
The main optimization contents are:
1. Add an automatic fusion switch for soul fusion
2. The team bar is classified according to the character type
3. Add gameplay and operation tips to the menu page
4. Modify the boss difficulty and add two groups of elite monsters
5. Modify some interface display errors and skill description errors

We will continue to pay attention to everyone's feedback and follow up on optimization and modification. Thank you for your support
